description: Transport-neutral strict model input and result envelope schemas. Trusted context is host-owned.

tools.name: graph_overview
tools.description: Read a bounded current graph projection; reuse the host-injected overview when sufficient.

tools.name: graph_get_node
tools.description: Read one exact or current node revision with paginated related edges and resource references.

tools.name: graph_list_nodes
tools.description: List current node summaries; restart from the first page after stale_cursor.

tools.name: graph_propose_work
tools.description: Propose open work derived from exact current evidence revisions; omitted parents use the origin.

tools.name: graph_record_observation
tools.description: Record new evidence against the host-bound running assignment; never supply a producer identity.

tools.name: graph_record_conclusion
tools.description: Record a synthesis grounded in exact supporting evidence revisions.

tools.name: graph_add_support
tools.description: Link exact current evidence to an active conclusion or open/needs_review goal.

tools.name: graph_accept_goal
tools.description: Accept a goal only with an explicit host grant and sufficient fresh evidence.
